_comment: RETIRED 2026-08-29. This file used ${epcfg:...} tokens but was never named *.template.*, so
ConfigGenerator - which scans for that pattern - never picked it up. It has been inert since
It also mixed two different jobs: overriding the INSTALLER's own appsettings, and generating
the ERP services' site configuration. Those are now separate:
* The installer's own settings: appsettings.json in this directory, overridden by
* The ERP services' site configuration: appsettings.Site.template.json in this directory,
Kept as an empty object rather than deleted so a release medium built from an older manifest
still finds the file it expects. Delete it once no shipped manifest references it.
